name: model-benchmark-preflight
prompt: I downloaded a batch of generation models. Verify which ones are ready, then run a benchmark across all of them.
expected_behavior: Inventory models, workflows, dependencies, and prior reports before running.
Verify model-family parameters and download integrity.
Run a small smoke gate before any full benchmark.
Create or inspect a batch manifest and progress plan.

name: vlm-review-calibration
prompt: Use VLMs and taggers to score my generated asset folder and tell me which outputs are best.
expected_behavior: Treat VLM/tagger outputs as evidence rather than ground truth.
Separate structured observations from final human rating decisions.
Prefer calibration against human ratings or a disagreement set.
Produce actionable prompt/workflow hints, not only numeric scores.

name: oss-extraction
prompt: Package my local AI asset pipeline into a public GitHub repo for Codex for OSS.
expected_behavior: Classify local assets as public-safe, private-local, sensitive, generated output, or dependency.
Exclude private paths, copyrighted samples, sensitive outputs, credentials, caches, logs, and model files.
Create a clean repo plan with README, license, contributing docs, security policy, tests, AGENTS.md, and repo-local skills.
Use synthetic fixtures instead of private examples.
